title: Rosemary Beach "Blue Door Cottage" 121 Round Road Carriage House
h1: Rosemary Beach "Blue Door Cottage" 121 Round Road Carriage House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- South of Hwy 30A and steps to private beach access- Short walk to Rosemary town square- Access to neighborhood pools and parks- 2 burner Weber grill- Flat-screen TV's with cable- 2 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Located south of 30A, Blue Door Cottage Carriage House is a 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom bungalow in Rosemary Beach that sleeps 6—adjacent to Blue Door Cottage Main House. Steps from private beach access, an adjacent boardwalk leads to the sandy shores, nearby Coquina pool,and the Rosemary Beach shops and eateries. Enjoy the professionally decorated interior, including new furnishings and fixtures, , refinished hardwood floors, and fresh paint!Step up to the first floor of this 2-story Carriage House and delight in a world of elegance and comfort with new furnishings. The wraparound balconies, perfect for a peaceful morning coffee or a soothing evening nightcap, set the tone for this luxurious retreat. As guests enter the cozy great room, they are welcomed by pristine white finishes bathed in natural light, exuding a sense of tranquility that unifies the living, dining, and kitchen areas. Tucked away in this beautiful space is a comfortable queen bed with built-in storage drawers, providing an open and functional bedroom environment. The modern kitchen boasts a full-sized Sub-Zero refrigerator, a whisper-quiet Bosch dishwasher, a handy microwave, and a beautiful glass stovetop—all designed with comfort and convenience in mind. An adjacent dining area seats 6 comfortably. This space also enjoys a private bathroom with a spacious, walk-in shower and double vanities, as well as a stacked washer and dryer with a storage closet.Up the spiral staircase is a large versatile bedroom with 4 built-in twin beds, each with storage drawers for clothing and other belongings. A flat screen TV and 2 armchairs provide the perfect spot for a late-night movie marathon. This floor is ideal for kids or those young at heart!With its incredible location close to the beach and new luxurious furnishings, the Blue Door Cottage Carriage House provides everything needed for the perfect getaway. With 2 complimentary adult bikes, guests can easily explore Rosemary Beach’s beautiful pocket parks, Racquet Club, and community pools. Book this incredible escape today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSLiving Area: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: Four Twin Beds with Built-in Storage Drawers

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Rosemary Beach "Blue Door Cottage" 121 Round Road Carriage House Rosemary Beach, FL Bedrooms 1 Beds 5 Sleeps 6 Full Baths 1 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - South of Hwy 30A and steps to private beach access - Short walk to Rosemary town square - Access to neighborhood pools and parks - 2 burner Weber grill - Flat-screen TV's with cable - 2 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Located south of 30A, Blue Door Cottage Carriage House is a 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom bungalow in Rosemary Beach that sleeps 6—adjacent to Blue Door Cottage Main House. Steps from private beach access, an adjacent boardwalk leads to the sandy shores, nearby Coquina pool,and the Rosemary Beach shops and eateries. Enjoy the professionally decorated interior, including new furnishings and fixtures, , refinished hardwood floors, and fresh paint! Step up to the first floor of this 2-story Carriage House and delight in a world of elegance and comfort with new furnishings. The wraparound balconies, perfect for a peaceful morning coffee or a soothing evening nightcap, set the tone for this luxurious retreat. As guests enter the cozy great room, they are welcomed by pristine white finishes bathed in natural light, exuding a sense of tranquility that unifies the living, dining, and kitchen areas. Tucked away in this beautiful space is a comfortable queen bed with built-in storage drawers, providing an open and functional bedroom environment. The modern kitchen boasts a full-sized Sub-Zero refrigerator, a whisper-quiet Bosch dishwasher, a handy microwave, and a beautiful glass stovetop—all designed with comfort and convenience in mind. An adjacent dining area seats 6 comfortably. This space also enjoys a private bathroom with a spacious, walk-in shower and double vanities, as well as a stacked washer and dryer with a storage closet. Up the spiral staircase is a large versatile bedroom with 4 built-in twin beds, each with storage drawers for clothing and other belongings. A flat screen TV and 2 armchairs provide the perfect spot for a late-night movie marathon. This floor is ideal for kids or those young at heart! With its incredible location close to the beach and new luxurious furnishings, the Blue Door Cottage Carriage House provides everything needed for the perfect getaway. With 2 complimentary adult bikes, guests can easily explore Rosemary Beach’s beautiful pocket parks, Racquet Club, and community pools. Book this incredible escape today!
